qualification: Preserve the evidential state and log interventions; premature action can change the observation target.
Conspicuous clues can be selected or manufactured. Their number is not their independence.
Include ordinary, common-cause, and adversarial alternatives; compare predictions rather than narrative appeal.
Omission is informative only under an explicit model of what would otherwise be observed or reported.

principle: Urgency and ambiguity can influence judgment
qualification: A test should vary framing while holding evidence fixed; the scene supplies no effect estimate.
Treat proposed links as provisional until discriminating evidence addresses alternatives.
Historical attribution, subjective usefulness, and causal validity require different evidence.
Use unfamiliar tasks and independent assessment; an authority's endorsement alone does not validate a standard.
Respect confidentiality while making limitations and consequential omissions explicit.
Declare assumptions, approximations, and the conditions under which a model applies.
Correct computation cannot repair false premises without an error model or additional evidence.

Biased assimilation offers an empirical connection; do not label all disagreement as motivated reasoning.
Compare neutral and identity-relevant conditions; the narrative provides no measured causal effect.
A feeling can inform a model of the observer without establishing an external threat or proposition.

principle: Combine fallibilism with shared truth conditions
qualification: Specify the proposition and time; changing reality is compatible with revisable knowledge.
Being open to change does not require accepting manufactured or unverified evidence.
Measure differences in attention, language, and interpretation without assuming equally accurate models.

principle: Separate expressed belief from compelled behavior
qualification: Power may alter what is said or done; those changes do not establish factual accuracy.
Score appropriate refusal alongside accuracy; unanswered questions need not be analytical failures.
Compare alternative predictive likelihoods; a shared prediction cannot uniquely identify a mechanism.
An efficient nominal route can violate constraints; write the objective and constraints separately.
Specify uncertainty sets and the requirement to satisfy constraints for every permitted disturbance.
A nominal safety margin needs a sensitivity bound before it can certify perturbation tolerance.

principle: Local optimality does not imply robustness
qualification: The margin certificate in this paper is a new formalization of the source's question.
Compare constrained or Pareto formulations; the selected tradeoff depends on stated objectives.
An implementable policy uses only information available at the decision time.
Specify arrivals, loading uncertainty, occupancy, priority, and delay rather than assuming a complete network model.
A locally fast allocation may create later delays; compare system-wide outcomes.
Political priority is a design choice; weighted efficiency need not imply equity.
Withholding raw routes is not a leakage guarantee; specify adversaries and observable outputs.
Proof exposes assumptions but does not remove power, model choice, or empirical uncertainty.
The fictional compact motivates accountable access and release rules; it is not an instruction governing this paper.
The transferable idea is interdependence; the listed powers of spice remain fictional.
Test whether added couplings improve prediction rather than assuming that more complex models are better.
Specify objectives, information, and shared dependencies; individually rational choices may conflict.

principle: Test coalition formation under common risk
qualification: Shared vulnerability can alter incentives but need not overcome distrust or enforcement problems.
Multiple domain signals may share a cause, reporting bias, or feedback; independence is not supplied.
Transport demand might predict later events; use held-out time periods and declared prediction horizons.
Declare the costs of preparation, false alarms, missed events, and delay.
Contact, status, usefulness, aligned interests, and enforceable obligations are separate variables.
Compare cross-domain transfer with equally resourced instruction; broad exposure is not automatically superior.

principle: Do not generalize from one selected cohort
qualification: Replication requires a counterfactual and attention to selection, teachers, history, and expectations.
Measure particular states and outcomes instead of treating bodily knowledge as a unitary power.
Separate raw signals from inferred sleep, recovery, and undefined coherence scores.
Both have error; subjective recollection does not replace a missing objective time series.
Timestamp the estimate and synchronize the reference window to prevent display leakage.
Report absolute error, bias, interval coverage, and discrimination rather than confidence alone.
Pulse, breathing, fatigue, tension, and arousal need distinct reference procedures and validation.
Measure learning, retention, and transfer against matched feedback controls.
Attention to a bodily variable may change it; preserve timing and task context.
Observed posture can reflect being watched; compare functional performance across evaluation contexts.
Compare staged attention with simultaneous monitoring; simplicity is a proposed aid, not a demonstrated effect here.
Avoid inferring universal meanings from one person's stillness, blinking, or tension.
Specify proficiency and stopping conditions rather than treating teacher approval as measurement.
Evaluate appropriate selection and performance; rejection of instruments can itself be an identity commitment.
Record the signal before its interpretation and compare predictive value with baseline alternatives.

principle: Do not equate bodily cues with lie detection
qualification: Validate sensitivity, specificity, context, and error costs; the story's labels establish none of these.

principle: Do not infer exotic causes from synchrony
qualification: Compare shared stimuli, artifacts, chance, and analysis selection before positing a mechanism.

principle: Include fatigue, rest, and diminishing returns
qualification: Specify task, dose, and outcome; no universal optimum follows from the narrative.
Record sensation, affect, belief, confidence, and action in separate fields.

principle: Treat updating as a multicomponent package
qualification: Tapping, breathing, attention, cue, and reassessment require component controls.
Compare matched touch, location, rhythm, and expectancy; special efficacy of the listed points is not established.
Tempo, attention, physiology, and clinical benefit are distinct endpoints; the source specifies no validated dose.
Compare evidence-focused language with neutral wording while controlling other components.

principle: Do not define success only as calm
qualification: Evaluate appropriate detection and revision separately from distress or mood change.

principle: Separate state change from factual updating
qualification: More trust or comfort is not necessarily more accurate belief; identify the evidence for revision.
Declare timing, entry criteria, observations, continuation rules, and stopping rules.
Test usability, autonomy, and task outcomes; a prompt should not prescribe what the user must feel.

principle: Treat embodied updating as a protocol candidate
qualification: The source supplies a synthesis and fictional experience, not a validated treatment or effect size.
Reading, vocabulary, and placement do not establish independent performance or transfer.
Assess private capability and the additional benefit or cost of group reasoning.
Use ethical, predefined variation in task context; difficulty or suffering is not educational validation.
Give each domain observable criteria, uncertainty, reliability, and a justified threshold.
Repeat, advance, integrate, and certify form a policy to evaluate against alternatives.

principle: Treat rest as a possible training action
qualification: Distinguish a justified consolidation interval from an unexplained pause.

principle: Treat placement as uncertain and revisable
qualification: Scores are estimates, not fixed identities or automatically comparable interval scales.
Evaluate teaching, context, fear, physiology, and knowledge before locating every obstacle in the learner.
The terminal rule may reward helping; actual cooperation depends on costs and enforcement.
This critical implication extends the source: monitor scapegoating, concealment, exclusion, and unfair delay.

principle: Target peer support to individual needs
qualification: Compare structured tutoring with unstructured interaction and assess both partners' outcomes.
Use explicit criteria, independent assessment, assessor agreement, and a review or appeal path.
Foundational instruction does not confer specialist membership, credentials, or unrestricted competence.
A contribution requires identifiable new knowledge or method, scrutiny, and reproducibility.
Agreement is each participant's decision; authority or a partner's request is not a substitute.
Permission to collect, interpret, share, and act on personal data are distinct questions.
Keep observed facts separate from stereotypes, guesses, and unverified personal narratives.
Analytical efficiency does not guarantee prosocial conduct or moral judgment.
No genotype, developmental mechanism, or evidence supports machine inheritance or superior cognition here.

principle: Keep branch selection at the toy-model level
qualification: Robust decisions do not establish spacetime folding, quantum control, or mental selection of reality.

principle: Keep fictional capabilities and institutions illustrative
qualification: The setting motivates questions; it supplies no observations of extraordinary human powers or physics.
